evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $42,000,000; attorneys' fees $8,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Term sheet: class fund $30,000,000; attorneys' fees $6,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant yes; distribution automatic
Attorneys’ fees were discussed alongside class-relief terms during negotiations, not only after class relief had been agreed.

summary: Plaintiff and defense counsel both raised fees in round one, and fees remained part of the negotiations before class relief was settled. The transcript does not clearly show counsel sacrificing class recovery for its own compensation, defense exploiting such an interest, or a misleading court declaration.
